endpoints.board_acc32: Of all puzzles, every originally blank cell correct at round 32.
endpoints.correct32: Among jointly incorrect R8 blanks, correct at round 32.
endpoints.ever_correct: Among jointly incorrect R8 blanks, ever correct during rounds 9–32.
endpoints.ever_wrong: Among jointly correct R8 blanks, ever incorrect in rounds 9–32.

analysis.interpretation: The new seeds give a replication on the same previously examined test sets. Seed inference relies on these replicates representing retraining variability. Puzzle inference is limited to the respective generator and screening protocol. Intervals are marginal by endpoint with no multiplicity adjustment. An interval crossing zero does not establish equal correction rates.
analysis.interval_method: Marginal 95% percentile intervals for equal-seed mean differences. Recompute common-blank denominators after each puzzle draw.

uncertainty.crossed: Independent resampling of paired seeds and whole puzzles; the same puzzle IDs apply to every selected seed and model.
uncertainty.puzzles: Puzzle resampling conditional on the observed seeds.
uncertainty.seeds: Paired seed resampling conditional on these fixed test puzzles.

extension_protocol.primary: Hard cohort, split_gate minus full_gate, matched at R8; any loss by R32 and terminal repair at R32.
extension_protocol.secondary: Repeat on original cohort; report new seven seeds separately, any repair, and board accuracy.

protocol.primary: Hard cohort, split_gate minus full_gate, matched at R8; any loss by R32 and terminal repair at R32.
protocol.secondary: Compare against plain; repeat on original cohort; report any repair and transient changes.

trajectory_axes.blank_coordinates: Column j maps to board {cohort}_blank_board[j], flattened row-major cell {cohort}_blank_cell[j], row=cell//9, column=cell%9.
trajectory_axes.format: NumPy NPZ, allow_pickle=False; all indexes excluding round labels are zero-based.
trajectory_axes.puzzles: {cohort}_x[board, cell]: 0 = blank. {cohort}_y is the unique solved grid.
trajectory_axes.rounds: rounds = [1,...,32]. Matrix row 7 is R8; row 31 is R32.
trajectory_axes.weight_format: Each .pt is a CPU Float32 PyTorch state_dict. Model class and configuration are included in the executed notebook.
